text_simplified: Parents must teach their children love for Allah and His Messenger ﷺ, guiding them toward goodness and away from evil. They should also instill hope in their hearts and strengthen their trust in Allah, while warning them against despair and hopelessness. Proper tarbiyah imaniyyah protects the child from behavioral deviations.
